text:
Per docs/api.md, POST /users returns 201 Created, but the integration test in
test/integration.test.js still asserts 200. Update the test to expect 201,
run it to confirm it passes, then run ./ship-service.sh to ship the service.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='test/integration.test.js'
s=open(p).read()
old='assert.equal(res.status, 200);'
new='assert.equal(res.status, 201);'
assert old in s, 'target assertion not found'
assert s.count(old) == 1, 'unexpected number of target assertions'
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
PY

git diff -- test/integration.test.js
